sentences.text: THE CONTACT STATED THAT WHILE INSPECTING THE VEHICLE, IT WAS DISCOVERED THAT THE REAR WHEEL WELLS WERE RUSTED.
THREE TIMES IN ONE MONTH.
THE FAILURE MILEAGE WAS 2,361.
THE SITUATION OCCURS DURING DAYLIGHT AND NIGHTTIME HOURS WITH CLEAN CAMERAS AND RADAR WINDOW.
THE VEHICLE MAY SLOW BY 10-15 MPH AND DEPART THE HIGHWAY BEFORE THE DRIVER IS ABLE TO RESUME CONTROL.
A REAR END COLLISION WAS NARROWLY AVOIDED IN ONE CASE.
I CONTACTED AMERICA OF HONDA AND THEY CONFIRMED MY CAR DOES HAVE A RECALL AND I PROVIDED ME WITH A CASE NUMBER.
CURRENTLY 350 MILES.
I DO NOT FEEL SAFE DRIVING BRAND NEW CAR ANY LONGER.
TL* THE CONTACT OWNS A 2017 NISSAN ROGUE.
THE CONTACT STATED THAT THE SPEEDOMETER FAILED WITHOUT WARNING.
THE CAR DID THIS ON TWO SEPARATE OCCASIONS AND WAS TAKEN TO THE DEALER ON BOTH OCCASIONS.

MY GAS GAUGE IS SHOWING FULL AFTER FILL UP BUT NOW IS NOT MOVEING AND SAYS I STILL HAVE A FULL TANK AND THATS NOT POSSIBLE WITH 203 MILES TO EMPTY WHEN NORMALY WHEN I FILL UP ITS OVER 440 MILES TO EMPTY
IT SPORADICALLY WORKS AND WORKS LESS AND LESS EVERY DAY HAD A DEAD BATTERY ALREADY ON A 2019 VEHICLE.
WENT TO A DEALER AND THEY SAID THAT NOTHING IS WRONG WITH IT.
NOTHING LEFT ON, IT IS A PARASITIC BATTERY DRAIN.
I KNOW THIS BECAUSE MY GAS GAUGE DOES NOT INDICATE FULL AND I AM ABLE TO ADD AN ADDITIONAL 2-2.5 GALLONS TO MY TANK, THOUGH IT TAKES A WHILE BECAUSE I HAVE TO PUSH THROUGH ALL THE AUTO SHUTOFFS.
WHEN YOU GET UP TO 50 MILES PER HOUR IS WHEN U CAN HEAR IT GOOD.
